segment_contamination_dimensions: Non-concrete prefabricated structures (wooden, steel, metal, bamboo, PVC, container, log) — buyers seeking material-specific alternatives are served by sibling MCATs (Wooden House, Steel House, Prefabricated Metal House, Container Homes, Bamboo Huts, Prefabricated Wooden House, Log Homes, Log Cabin) and names must not attract those buyer segments

Leisure, hospitality, and recreational dwelling buyers (beach house, resort, cottage, tree house) — served by sibling MCATs (Prefabricated Beach House, Portable Resort, Modular Cottages, Tree House) and names must not attract resort or vacation-home buyers

Guard/security post buyers seeking small sentry structures — served by sibling MCATs (Guard Huts, PVC Guard Huts) and names must not conflate residential housing with guard post procurement; trade name 'precast guard room' and 'precast site office' were discarded from enhanced names on this basis

Portable/temporary structure buyers (portable cabin, portable house, bunkhouse) — served by sibling MCATs (Portable House, Bunkhouses, Prefab Steel Bunk House, MS Bunkhouse, Bunk House Office, Portable Huts) and names must not emphasise portability or temporary deployment as the primary attribute
